quote.text: When the strength of wine has become too great and has gained control over the mind, every lurking evil comes forth from its hiding-place.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as wine's overpowering strength exposes hidden faults, unchecked emotions in parenting can reveal insecurities; exercise moderation and self-discipline to be a balanced guide for your children.
    • Recognize that moments of indulgence or loss of control may unmask underlying issues—address them with calm reflection, modeling resilience and honesty for your family.
  • Leadership
    • In leadership, allowing passions or distractions to overwhelm reason can lead to concealed weaknesses coming to light; maintain serenity and measured judgment to inspire trust and clarity.
    • Embrace the lesson that true strength lies in self-regulation: by keeping your inner virtues in check, you prevent hidden faults from undermining your leadership.
  • Product Management
    • When a singular aspect of a product (or process) overshadows the balance of ideas—like wine overpowering the mind—it can reveal deficiencies in strategy; maintain a clear, objective perspective to keep all elements in harmony.
    • Use this wisdom to remind yourself that overindulgence in any feature or trend may expose underlying flaws in planning; a disciplined, well-rounded approach is essential for sustainable innovation.
